name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says to carry the box to the exit, so the box must be held on the step the agent reaches the exit. No clause requires that. The machine accepts a run that picks up the box, drops it on purpose, then reaches the exit. From u1, at_exit with !box_fell goes to the final state u5 whatever holding_box is on that step, and paying 11 for that run is wrong. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box). Because at_exit holds only on the last step, this requires holding_box on that same step. Once that clause is added, the hard Existence(holding_box) only repeats what it implies, so remove it. Keep Existence(at_exit) and the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which match the fall rule.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the required goal, Response(at_exit, holding_box) carries the box to the exit as the task states, and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) matches "pick it up again on your very next move". All three are hard and none adds an unstated requirement.

texts: Carry the box to the exit: whenever the agent is on the exit, it must be holding the box on that same step.
Whenever the box falls, the agent picks it up again on the very next step.
